issue.title: Beat crash after Redis SERVER_CLOSED_CONNECTION_ERROR
issue.body:
We have noticed that the beat process crashes occasionally after dealing with a Redis SERVER_CLOSED_CONNECTION_ERROR.

After:

```
2025-02-26T10:38:56.177557+0000 ERROR signal.py:280 celery.utils.dispatch.signal Signal handler  raised: ConnectionError('Connection closed by server.')
```

The beat process can crash with:

```
2025-02-26T10:38:56.371792+0000 CRITICAL beat.py:115 celery.beat beat raised exception : AttributeError("'NoneType' object has no attribute 'extend'")
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "celery/apps/beat.py", line 113, in start_scheduler
    service.start()
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^
  File "celery/beat.py", line 643, in start
    interval = self.scheduler.tick()
  File "redbeat/schedulers.py", line 485, in tick
    self.lock.extend(int(self.lock_timeout))
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'extend'
```
